# ghost/photos

Google Photos without an account: list on-device photos and videos with dates and folders, open one in the viewer, check the Trash.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/photos
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/photos list_photos --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/photos open_photo --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/photos count_trash --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `list_photos`: What photos do I have on this phone?
- `open_photo`: Show me my latest photo
- `count_trash`: Is there anything in my Photos trash?
